lines.text: You throw my heart out like a paper plane at night
It always finds its way right back into your light
I swear I’m walking straight, I’m trying to break free
But every road I take still curves right back to me
It’s crazy how it circles, crazy how it spins
No matter where I go, it pulls me in again
Boomerang, boomerang, you got me spinning ‘round and ‘round
Every time I think I’m gone, you bring me crashing down
But I don’t fight the fall, ‘cause when I land it’s you
Boomerang, boomerang — I’m coming back to you
I tried to build a wall, I tried to change the game
But your name keeps echoing inside my chest like rain
You laugh and say “I told you so,” and maybe you were right
This heart of mine was always meant to fly back home tonight
It’s crazy how it circles, crazy how it spins
No matter where I go, it pulls me in again
Boomerang, boomerang, you got me spinning ‘round and ‘round
Every time I think I’m gone, you bring me crashing down
But I don’t fight the fall, ‘cause when I land it’s you
Boomerang, boomerang — I’m coming back to you
Maybe I don’t wanna break the chain
Maybe I like the way it feels to come back again
Boomerang, boomerang, you got me spinning ‘round and ‘round
Every time I think I’m gone, you bring me crashing down
I’m done pretending I don’t love the way you pull me through
Boomerang, boomerang — I’m coming back to you
